## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

HrHistoryReader — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/health/HrHistoryReader.kt

## Trigger

ProfileViewModel calling `hrHistoryReader.bpmValuesOverLast12Months()` on
the first `Profile` emission carrying a null `hrMaxBpm` — observed

## Today

`HrHistoryReader` is an interface only, its doc comment stating an
implementation backed by Health Connect is not part of this lot.
`ProfileViewModel` already depends on it and calls
`bpmValuesOverLast12Months()`, but only `FakeHrHistoryReader`
(`ProfileViewModelTest.kt`) and `ScreenTestHrHistoryReader`
(`ProfileScreenTest.kt`) exist as implementations, both test doubles.
No production implementation exists in `:app-phone`, and no Hilt
binding supplies one to `ProfileViewModel`'s real construction.

## Expected

`HrHistoryReader` gets a Health-Connect-backed implementation, living
in `:app-phone` — per `TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md` §3, anything touching
the device's OS lives in the application module using it, and Health
Connect is phone-only per §1. It reads every heart-rate bpm reading
recorded over the last 12 months through the Health Connect client and
returns them as `bpmValuesOverLast12Months()`. `gradle/libs.versions.toml`
carries no Health Connect client dependency today
(`androidx.health.connect:connect-client` or equivalent); it needs to be
added to the version catalogue and declared on `:app-phone` before the
implementation can be written.
